maintenance_led.reason: Sells new orthopedic braces, rehab devices, bone growth stimulators and surgical implants, which are first-time purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly from hospitals, clinics, consumers and private and commercial insurers for braces, implants and devices, not mainly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its orthopedic and recovery products and launching new ones; it has made only occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Braces and rehab devices can be swapped for other brands; surgeon implant familiarity adds some friction.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline because surgeons are trained on specific implant systems.
